summary: HP introduced the HP Engage One Pro G2q, an enterprise-grade Android all-in-one POS platform powered by the Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-6690 processor running Android 16 with Google Mobile Services, as part of its push into enterprise Android for retail and hospitality.
HP also introduced the HP Engage One G2 AIO, featuring a thin 15.6-inch landscape display in an ultra-slim aluminum chassis for retail and hospitality point-of-sale environments.

HP's Engage POS hardware line supports one of the broadest sets of operating systems in retail (Windows, Windows IoT, Linux, and Android), positioning HP as an OS-agnostic hardware supplier rather than a full software/payments platform.
